name: github-app
title: Deploy from GitHub
description: Builds a public GitHub repository's Dockerfile on one of your machines and runs it. When the branch gets a new commit, the pool builds and deploys it again by itself. Files the app writes to /data move with it.
author: sys1

inputs.name: BRANCH
inputs.label: Branch to follow (empty: the default branch)

inputs.name: PORT
inputs.label: Port the app listens on (opened on the machine too)

inputs.name: DIR
inputs.label: Folder with the Dockerfile (empty: the top)
